prompt: Long telephoto shot at night from the far verge of a level road, flattened and side-on. Two black 1920s sedans run side by side, door to door, the nearer one hiding the lower half of the other, with one driver in each behind dark glass. A short spray of white-gold sparks bursts from where their doors touch. Behind them a low stone wall, then a dark river that stays well beyond the road, its far bank a line of amber lights against indigo sky. No lettering, nothing else on the road. Thanks.
